purpose: Portable EdgeAI weighted-matrix CPU LBS applied to Last Island recreated seven-mesh Unity-derived skeleton

startup_screenshot_comparison.comparison: recreated build vs recreated build, not against original

methodology: Deduplicated timestamped LIOS_FRAME_TIMING and LIOS_PHASE_TIMING records from overlapping archived Android logcat snapshots; 60 frames per unique window. CPU wall-clock phases, not GPU timing.
limitations: Runs were different emulator sessions and interaction windows, not controlled A/B experiments.
Measured FPS remains below 30 on full candidate sample; last five windows are not representative of all frames.
Unity LITE 7.3 same-state original screenshot and original binary functional comparison not available.
Pixel stability between recreated builds does not prove original-game parity.
Android emulator uses x86_64 with ARM64 translation; native ARM64 physical GPU performance not measured.
